title: Farm Equipment Maintenance Checklist Form
subtitle: Farm Equipment route the work, prepare controls, record tasks and parts, test the result, manage unresolved conditions, and authorize return to use.
description: An original, workflow-complete farm equipment maintenance checklist covering identity and routing, domain observations and evidence, accountable decisions, exceptions and escalation, and completion handoff without replacing qualified judgment.
use_case: Use for scheduled or corrective maintenance that needs task evidence, measurements, parts traceability, function checks, restrictions, and handoff. The record is owned by the fleet or farm operations owner and closes only after evidence, exceptions, disposition, and the next accountable handoff are documented.

sections.title: Farm Equipment maintenance routing
sections.guidance: Identify the work, subject, assigned person, and review owner.

blocks.label: Maintenance Checklist identity and routing
blocks.guidance: Assign one owner and use the same record ID in attachments and follow-up.

blocks.label: Equipment Asset identity
blocks.guidance: Preserve the identifiers used by the controlling farm, facility, or partner record.

sections.title: Farm Equipment work preparation
sections.guidance: Record instructions, condition, controls, and parts before work.

blocks.label: Pre-work review and controls
items: Pre-use condition review recorded
Fuel or charge level recorded
Fluid condition and visible leaks observed
Tires, tracks, or ground-contact parts observed
Guards, controls, and alerts checked per site policy
Attachment identity and connection status recorded
Meter change reconciled to the activity
Post-use restriction or service need recorded

sections.title: Farm Equipment maintenance tasks
sections.guidance: Record completed tasks separately from measurements and findings.

blocks.label: Farm Equipment task checklist
items: Energy-control status recorded under site procedure
Exterior, steps, and access areas examined
Lubrication points serviced per current manual
Fluid levels, filters, and leak evidence recorded
Belts, chains, hoses, and connections observed
Tires, tracks, wheels, and fasteners observed
Controls, brakes, steering, and indicators checked
Guards, shields, and interlocks reviewed
Attachment points and implement functions checked
Post-service function test and restrictions recorded

sections.title: Farm Equipment parts and service evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve material, service, and removed-part traceability.

blocks.label: Work performed, deviations from plan, and supporting references

sections.title: Farm Equipment function test and decision
sections.guidance: Separate the test evidence from return-to-use authorization.

blocks.label: Function and handback evidence
items: Farm Equipment before-and-after results support the recorded status
Tasks, measurements, parts, and outside service are documented
Function testing is separate from return-to-use authorization
Restrictions and unfinished work have owners and due points
Qualified review was obtained where work or disposition exceeds authority

sections.title: Farm Equipment unresolved conditions
sections.guidance: Preserve restrictions and route decisions beyond the maintainer’s authority.

blocks.label: Maintenance authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This record documents equipment workflow; it does not declare an asset safe or authorize work. Stop or restrict use when a condition falls outside the current manual or site procedure, and route the decision to a qualified person.

blocks.label: Farm Equipment unresolved-condition triggers
items: Asset identity or meter is missing
Inspection or service interval cannot be verified
Defect remains open or condition changed
Attachment or task compatibility is unresolved
Operator assignment or access is unresolved
Required manual, part, or work record is unavailable

blocks.label: Restriction, immediate action, owner, due point, and final disposition

sections.title: Farm Equipment maintenance closeout
sections.guidance: Transfer restrictions, next service, and evidence to operations.

blocks.label: Farm Equipment open actions and limitations
blocks.guidance: Carry forward every item that is not fully resolved at closeout.

blocks.label: Farm Equipment handoff confirmations
items: Work, measurements, parts, and removed material were reconciled
Restrictions and unfinished work were transferred to operations
Next maintenance, inspection, or verification point was assigned
Farm Equipment return-to-use handback was acknowledged
Work records, manuals, photos, and service evidence were filed
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items remain part of the open handoff.

blocks.label: Final outcome, remaining limits, communications, and acceptance notes
